CLASSIFICATION: DCSE Command Post - ESCD Dashboard Full CRUD, Assets Parity, DDNA Schema Fix and Multi-Type File Attachments
ACTION: Dashboard first-column tabs full CRUD operations, Assets parity, DDNA schema correction (dcse_cp), and universal file attachment upload/save

root_causes: Assets tab lacked Add form, detail inspection, editing, and deletion handlers.
DDNA queries referenced legacy schema 'dcse_ddna_legacy', which did not exist on the PostgREST server, throwing 406 Not Acceptable.

First column tabs (Workflows, Metrics, Deliverables, Actions, Evidence, Governance) only opened a read-only payload alert on 'Edit' click rather than allowing field edits, lifecycle updates, deletion, or file attachments.
No backend or UI mechanism existed for uploading and persisting file attachments across arbitrary ESCD record types.
resolutions: Fixed DDNA PostgREST queries from dcse_ddna_legacy to dcse_cp in apps/escd/runtime/mvp_data.py.
Added CRUD operations for Assets (create, patch, delete) and DDNA sources (create, patch, delete) in mvp_data.py and API routes in apps/escd/api/mvp.py and api/mvp.py.
Added save_file_attachment with dual storage support: Supabase Storage bucket 'escd-files' with automatic base64 data URI fallback.

Constructed unified record detail modal (<dialog id='recordModal'>) with full field editing, status transitions, priority toggling, file attachments manager (upload, preview/download, remove), DDNA job log inspection, raw JSON toggle, and archive/delete controls.
Added initial file attachment upload inputs directly to item creation cards.
Added unit test suite apps/escd/tests/test_mvp_crud_attachments.py validating all endpoints, schemas, and file attachments (full suite passed: 209/209).
FINDINGS.verification_result: Production live smoke tests passed with HTTP 200 OK. UI bundle confirmed to serve recordModal, addAsset, addDDNA, and uploadFileToRecord. Full parity and CRUD operational.
